name: TestSelection
summary: Chooses at run time which of the available tests to run, so that a subset can be run without a suite being written for it.

roles.name: TestSelection
roles.summary: The filter applied to what discovery or enumeration produced — by category, by name, by whatever the team decided. It is worth naming because a selection that excludes more than anybody realises is indistinguishable, from the report, from a suite that passed.
